title: Exiled Magician’s Afterwards: Starting a Slow Life in a New Land
description: Rain, a reincarnated youth, spent his days hunting monsters on the frontier as part of the Anti-Demon Noble Family. In accordance with the tradition of marrying a royal daughter on his fifteenth birthday, he visits the royal palace for the very first time in his life, only to find himself ensnared in a web of swirling conspiracies...
author: Taro Sato
